name: BepInEx 5 plugin
summary: A plugin dll for Unity Mono games. The usual choice for Lethal Company, R.E.P.O., Valheim and most Unity games.
description: A C# class library that BepInEx 5 loads from BepInEx\plugins. Pick the game and the project references its own assemblies and copies the built dll into the game after every build.

options.label: Mod name
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only

options.label: Author
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only
options.help: Goes into the plugin GUID, which must never change once people use the mod.

options.label: Game folder
options.help: The folder with the game's exe. Leave empty to add the game dlls by hand later.

options.label: Target framework
options.help: Set from the game's Unity version when a game is picked.

options.label: Unity version
options.help: Only used when no game folder is set: Unity's assemblies then come from NuGet.

options.label: Harmony patches
options.help: A Patches folder with an example of changing a game method.

options.label: Config file
options.help: Settings saved to BepInEx\config that players can edit.

options.label: Hotkey
options.help: A key press handler in Update.

options.label: On-screen window
options.help: A small IMGUI window, the base of a mod menu.

options.label: Access private game members
options.help: Publicizes Assembly-CSharp at build time so private fields and methods compile.

Only load in this game's exe

next: Open the folder in Visual Studio, Rider or VS Code.
The dll is in bin\Release. With a game folder set it is also copied to BepInEx\plugins in the game.
Start the game and look for the plugin's line in BepInEx\LogOutput.log.
Your code starts in Plugin.cs, in Awake.
